text:
mina_ops: FYI SIN depot holding 6 units from NovaChip due to HS code mismatch (vendor marked as 'server_parts' but SIN customs requested 'gpu_accelerator'). Impact: ~18 GPUs offline in APAC pool after staging.
jonathan_procurement: Contacted NovaChip. They say it's a paperwork error on their side, can reissue docs but expedite fee for corrected MAWB is 6% if we want air-courier reissue. Sea reissue no fee but 12-18 days.
sanjay_netops: Short-term: can we burst to hosted cloud region ap-southeast-1 for latency-sensitive endpoints? Egress cost higher but preserves p99 for chat.
ashley_logistics: For RMA/returns NovaChip requires original packing photos + serial manifest and signed commercial invoice with corrected HS. They will only issue return AWB after docs accepted.
nova_support: Confirmed - we will reissue corrected MAWB within 4 hours if customer accepts air correction fee and provides broker details. We can also send 2 temporary loaner A800s for 5 days if expedited.
mina_ops: Loaners would be helpful. Which SKU for loaner? A800 compatible with our runtime?
nova_support: A800 loaners are compatible at reduced throughput profile; no warranty transfer. We'll include config notes and a mapping file.
jonathan_procurement: Cost options: (A) air correction + 6% (~$7,200) + broker pre-clear (recommended for SLA), or (B) sea docs free but +14 days. Recommended A given four enterprise tenants in APAC.
sanjay_netops: I'll route traffic for affected tenants to hosted burst and throttle non-priority inference. Need an estimate of token-cost delta.
jonathan_procurement: Estimated token cost delta for 7 days of cloud burst ~$12k. Combined with 6% expedite is cheaper than SLA credits. Finance sign-off needed.
vendorbot: Manifest note: provisional MAWB NC-88112; corrected docs pending. Loaner AWB will be generated within 24h of docs accepted.
ashley_logistics: Action: ashley to collect serials & depot photos now, upload to NovaChip portal; mina to approve expedite; jonathan to push PO.
mina_ops: Agreed to expedite. Pulling serials now. Ash, please use photo checklist "top_label, underside_label, serial_barcode, packaging_damage, host_id".
jonathan_procurement: PO created PO-9001. Tag cost center infra-apac. Sending for finance approval.
ashley_logistics: Upload complete. Manifest ID: SIN-MNL-7782. NovaChip portal shows docs received.
nova_support: Docs received. Issuing loaner AWB NCLOAN-334 within 12h. Corrected MAWB issued - NC-88112-REV. Expect customs clearance within 48-72h with our broker partner.
mina_ops: Thanks. I'll update incident and keep routing changes on standby. Closing followups: jonathan (PO & finance), ashley (upload & tracker), sanjay (burst routing), nova_support (loaner + MAWB).
